name: Wockhardt Ltd
about: Wockhardt is a global pharmaceutical and biotechnology organization engaged in manufacturing finished dosage formulations, injectables, biopharmaceuticals, orals and topicals (creams and ointments). [1]
key_points: Business Divisions: a) New Drug Discovery: [1] [2] The company’s New Drug Discovery programme focuses on developing novel antibiotics to address the growing threat of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) and unmet needs in treating MDR and XDR infections. It follows a “discovery-to-delivery” approach, advancing first-in-class and differentiated antibiotics from research and clinical development to commercialisation across India and inter national markets. During FY26, 5 novel antibiotics, including Emrok, Emrok O, Miqnaf, Zaynich , and Foviscu , completed Phase 3 development, while Odrate progressed to Phase 2. The portfolio covers infections including MRSA, ESBL-producing and carbapenem-resistant pathogens, pneumonia and complicated urinary tract infections. b) Branded Pharmaceuticals: [3] The company is engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of finished formulations, biopharmaceuticals, branded generics, OTC, and prescription products across various therapeutic segments. Its key biopharmaceutical products include Glaritus, Wosulin, Wepox, and recombinant human insulin . It ranks among the Top 3 in around 20 products in the US, among the Top 5 generic companies in the UK, and as the largest ** generic company in Ireland’s hospital segment. c) Contract Manufacturing: [4] The company offers contract manufacturing services from product development to high-volume commercial manufacturing. Its full turnkey service is supported by experienced teams across development, technology transfer, manufacturing, quality assurance, regulatory affairs, logistics, engineering, and purchasing. d) Biosimilar: [5] [6] The company focuses on developing and manufacturing biosimilar and bio better products, with diabetes as a key focus area. Its portfolio includes rapid, fast, and long-acting insulin formulations, available in vials and cartridges, along with patented insulin pens. It has applied for 118 biotech product patents globally and holds 57 patents in the biosimilar and bio-better development phase, out of which 23 patents are for the company’s insulin pen globally. In FY26, the company has obtained patents in 10 European countries for its new combination drug product. e) Vaccines: [7] [8] The company manufactures vaccines across its UK and India facilities. Its Wrexham facility has manufactured the AstraZeneca-Oxford COVID-19 vaccine , and the company has partnered with the Serum Institute of India for vaccine manufacturing in the UK. Its Indian facilities are approved for vaccine manufacturing and exports of up to 1 Bn doses. f) API: [9] The company manufactures complex APIs and formulations and has developed 140+ US ANDAs and 60+ EU CTD dossiers, covering multiple dosage forms and niche products. It is also among the largest** manufacturers of Dextromethorphan HBr API globally and explores licensing opportunities across the US and Europe.

profile.summary: Wockhardt Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a pharmaceutical and biotech company, in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It manufactures and trades pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemical, and botanical products, as well as chemicals and chemical products. The company also develops its flagship antibiotic, ZAYNICH zidebactam/cefepime, a novel beta lactam enhancer mechanism for the treatment of sepsis and hospital/ventilator associated pneumonia; FOVISCU, an antibiotic for gram-negative infections; MIQNAF nafithromycin, which targets azithromycin-resistant community respiratory pathogens; and ODRATE, a once-daily combination of ertapenem and zidebactam for resistant gram-negative infections through outpatient parenteral antimicrobial therapy. In addition, it develops and commercializes insulin analogs, glucagon-like peptide-1 agonists, and novel combination drug products; Biovac-B, a recombinant hepatitis-B vaccine; Wepox, a recombinant human erythropoietin; Wosulin, a recombinant human insulin; and Glaritus, a recombinant insulin glargine, as well as offers insulin aspart regular and biphasic drug products. Further, the company offers delivery devices for insulin, including DispoPen disposable pen and Mypen reusable pen. Wockhardt Limited was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
